prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent two-part mini atlas for the existing side-view Tyrannosaurus game puppet.
The supplied image is a MATERIAL/IDENTITY REFERENCE, not an edit target: match its muted bronze-brown and olive irregular reptile scales, warm lighter underside and dark horn claws. Improve natural anatomy; no metallic toy or glossy rubber.
Create EXACTLY TWO fully separate organic cutout pieces on a wide transparent canvas, no other body parts:
LEFT: a SINGLE compact sturdy ankle-to-toe-root metatarsal shaft. Its long axis vertically down, mild natural taper, roughly 2.0 to 2.2 times as long as its widest diameter. Thick tendon-bearing middle; gently rounded overlap allowance at both ends contained within anatomical width, NO giant knob, NO extra knee, NO toe/heel/foot attached. A shorter stout source silhouette suitable for ONE bone, NOT a slender long rod.
RIGHT: a Tyrannosaurus three-forward-toed FOOT ONLY in strict orthographic SIDE view facing RIGHT, heel/toe root at LEFT. Three articulated scaly toes overlap naturally in depth and each ends in a restrained dark curved pointed claw. Longest toe extends horizontally right; the two other toes stagger slightly but remain visible as side silhouettes. Weight-bearing toes form a low continuous bottom resting line. The whole foot silhouette should be LOW and compact: roughly 2.7 to 3.0 times wider than high including its attachment. Remove the old reference's shoe-like solid wedge, tall ankle stump and big upper round cap. Toe-root at upper LEFT is a shallow smooth convex socket-cover overlap, only ~one fifth of foot height, no hollow pipe, no hard horizontal cut. No metatarsal shaft attached to the foot. Real fleshy toe joints integrated into skin, not separate beads. No backwards human heel, no human shoes.
Composition: two pieces each entirely isolated, centered in left and right halves with wide transparent separation and at least 8 percent transparent outer margin. Both pieces neutral and unposed, same scale-cell density, same clean soft studio lighting from upper left, no ground shadow, labels, layout marks, text, watermark or background. Preserve crisp actual alpha transparency. Do not reproduce unrelated pieces from reference.
